name: motion-number-input
blurb: Number input with animated digit transitions and increment/decrement buttons.
description: A controlled number input using the NumberFlow library for smooth animated digit transitions, with +/- buttons to adjust value, input validation, and min/max bounds.
use_when: Building counters, quantity selectors, or forms where animated number changes provide visual feedback.
avoid_when: On systems where animation performance is critical or for simple unadorned number inputs.
a11y: Semantic number input with keyboard support; +/- buttons are aria-hidden as they mirror direct input control.
